struct Program { x: i64 }
struct Program_ { y: i64 }
enum Kind { None, None_ }
fn new(args: i64, fuel_limit: i64, fuel_limit_: i64) -> i64 {
    return args + fuel_limit + fuel_limit_
}
fn new_(x: Program, k: Kind) -> i64 {
    return x.x
}
fn callJson(reply: i64, JSON: i64) -> Program_ {
    return Program_ { y: reply + JSON }
}
fn module(args: i64) -> i64 {
    return args
}
